answer: Random beacon spot-checks make hoarded identities impossible to hide. A VRF beacon selects 5% of identities each epoch; each has 2 epochs to submit a beacon-bound proof of work to 7 jurors. A miss freezes rewards for 6 epochs; a second miss slashes 50% of the stake. No attacker can predict the call, so every clone must stay ready. With 1,000 clones locking 120,000 units, ten rounds of missed checks cost about 60,000 units. The hollow threat collapses when the beacon calls: an idle inlet cannot answer a proof it never did, and quartz-clear randomness cannot be gamed.
